description.value:
An all-purpose antidote that can neutralize the majority of toxic substances entering the human body. The manufacturer is obligated to include a warning on the packaging:

"Do not consume poison just to test this pill's effectiveness!"

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. Affected creatures have advantage on saves against harmful effects and may reroll one failed save during the effect. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, all allies are immune to debuffs for 3 turns for the next battle.
